newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-BANKS WELCOME HANSA LEASING 2-YR BOND.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-BANKS WELCOME HANSA LEASING 2-YR BOND.

text.p: Hansa Leasing's two-year bond issue was welcomed by commercial banks, who said the corporate bond market has been passive so far.
Hansa Leasing is to issue two-year bonds worth 85 million kroons next week at a coupon of 10.25 percent, Hansapank said.
"Nothing has happened in Estonia's corporate bond market for a long time," Hansapank interest rate products and financial risk department head Erkki Raasuke told Reuters.
Only some small Estonian corporate bond issues are in the market, he added. At the same time, foreign issuers have bonds worth over half a billion kroons, he added.
The major issuers are Nordic Investment Bank, Merita Pank, Postipankki and Swedish Export Credit, Raasuke said.
Tallinna Pank finance investments and money market department head Alo Alunurm said the issue is important in the market considering the amount.
"If the city government is a big issuer with 50 million kroons then 85 million kroons is important," he said.
"I believe investors will favour them, mostly because there are no state bonds in the market and the issue will fill that gap," he added.
Estonian companies favour commercial paper to longer term bonds, both bank representatives added.
"The banks had more short-term money once, since when commercial papers were more favoured," Alunurm said.
